subject: Rainwell security intake & incident timeline discussion
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Amit Shah <amit@rainwell.ai>, Sofie Lindgren <sofie@rainwell.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, Nov 3, 2026 at 9:12 AM PST
Subject: Rainwell — post-demo security & compliance next steps

Hi Amit / Sofie,

Thanks again for the demo today — great conversation and lots of alignment on how Redwood can help with predictable inference for Rainwell's clinical analytics pipeline. As promised, a concise recap and a few asks so we can move the security review forward: 

- Action items for Rainwell: please confirm SOC 2 status (Type I/II + reporting period) and whether you consider HIPAA in-scope for this integration.
- Action items for Redwood: we can provide a SOC 2 summary, an excerpt from our IR/BCP playbook, and a draft SLA clause for breach notification.

Specific asks we need to progress procurement/security: 
1) Start the vendor security questionnaire you sent during the call (we'll ingest it into our tracker). Please attach the version you'd like us to fill out.
2) Incident response expectations: Rainwell mentioned wanting a notification window to customers for security incidents — can you confirm target windows (e.g., 48, 72 hours)?
3) BCP/DR: please share any RTO/RPO thresholds you require (for example: RTO <= 4 hours for critical inference).

Attachments: meeting-recording-link (shared separately).

I'll loop in Marissa (CS lead) and Neha (security) to prepare drafts and evidence. If it's helpful, we can propose a tabletop timeline next week.

Best,
Sean
Sean Gallagher | Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
From: Sofie Lindgren <sofie@rainwell.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Amit Shah <amit@rainwell.ai>
Cc: procurement@rainwell.ai
Date: Wed, Nov 4, 2026 at 10:37 AM CET
Subject: Re: Rainwell — post-demo security & compliance next steps

Hi Sean, Amit here (copied Sofie for procurement).

Thanks — attaching our vendor security questionnaire (current baseline). Two immediate notes from Rainwell security/legal: 
- SOC 2: we require a Type II report for production integrations; if Redwood has Type I only, please provide the timeline for Type II completion and any compensating controls.
- Data privacy: Rainwell needs confirmation about GDPR data processing roles and whether any PHI will be stored or processed (HIPAA). If PHI may be transmitted, we will need BAA language.

On incident response/notification: our legal team is asking for a proposed customer notification timeline. Their baseline is 72 hours but would consider 48 hours depending on severity classification and forensic confirmation. Can Redwood indicate:
  a) Typical lead time to detect + verify an incident (average MTTR if you track it).
  b) Proposed customer notification cadence (initial notice, follow up with root cause, remediation timeline).

We would also like: RTO / RPO targets, and a short list of artifacts we can request for procurement (SOC 2 report, SSP, IR playbook excerpt, penetration test summary).

Attachments: rainwell_vendor_questionnaire_v1.docx

Best,
Sofie
Sofie Lindgren
Head of Procurement, Rainwell AI
procurement@rainwell.ai
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, Nov 5, 2026 at 08:22 AM PST
Subject: Re: Rainwell — post-demo security & compliance next steps

Sean / Marissa —

I've drafted initial responses to Rainwell's questionnaire and pulled the following artifacts we can provide quickly:
- SOC 2 summary (we currently have a Type II attestation for our control plane through June 2026; full report available under NDA).
- IR playbook excerpt (redwood_ir_playbook_excerpt.pdf) — includes notification thresholds and escalation matrix.
- Pen test summary (redwood-pen-test-summary-2026.txt).

On the incident timeline questions from Rainwell:
- Detection/verification: our median time-to-detect is ~2 hours for classified severity 1/2 events; average time-to-contain ~6 hours depending on scope.
- Notification: draft proposal: initial customer notification within 72 hours with an intent to notify within 48 hours for confirmed data-exfiltration incidents affecting customer data. Formal timeline: initial notification (24-72 hrs), followed by a forensic update within 5 business days, and a root-cause/remediation report within 30 days — more urgent cadence for regulatory-impacting events.
- BCP/DR: for inference endpoints we offer options: warm standby (RTO < 4 hours), cold failover (RTO 24–48 hours); typical RPO depends on caching and KV-store configuration — we can quantify per-customer during onboarding.

I need Marissa to confirm whether we can share the full pen test summary to Rainwell procurement without an NDA in place, and Rishi to review the proposed 48-hour notification carveout.

Neha
Neha Kapoor | Security Principal | Redwood Inference
